title: Pandemic Ritual Queen
description: A tall, black, hooded figure with a white crown of radiating orbs stands against a solid black background. The lower portion of the figure and the foreground are covered in overlapping colorful translucent circles containing occult symbols, spiders, pentagrams, and the text 'PANDEMIC RITUAL OF KINGS & CHAOS', with a white hand extending from the robe holding a chain of yellow rings.
prompt: A surreal symbolic painting featuring a tall black hooded figure with a white crown of radiating orbs and a single white hand emerging from the robe holding a chain of golden rings. The bottom of the robe and foreground are filled with overlapping colorful translucent circles in purple green and yellow containing occult symbols, spiders, pentagrams and text reading 'PANDEMIC RITUAL OF KINGS & CHAOS', solid black background, mystical and eerie atmosphere.
